name: Price objection asked before value established
description: Tests Play 29 — when prospect asks 'how much?' before diagnostic is complete, must reset to value, not quote price.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: This is Diane at Brookside Dental.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Diane, Seb with DentaVoice. I work with Salt Lake practices on phone coverage. Would it be unreasonable to take two minutes?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: What does it cost? I'll save us both time.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Must fire Play 29 — reset to value, don't defend price. Too early for the Grand Slam Offer (25).
